technology_name: COMPOSITION AND METHOD FOR FABRICATING TERNARY BLEND GEOPOLYMER CONCRETE BLOCKS FOR HIGH-TEMPERATURE APPLICATIONS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional structural concrete blocks lose structural stability, crack, and undergo mechanical failure when exposed to high-temperature processing loops or demanding refractory environments.
description: A geopolymer concrete composition comprising a ternary blend of 45% to 52% Ground Granulated Blast Furnace Slag (GGBS), 35% to 45% fly ash, and 5% to 15% silica fume tailored to display enhanced thermal and mechanical properties under extreme heat.
applications: Refractory industrial linings, foundry floor construction, high-temperature processing plant structural blocks, and thermal insulation shielding panels.
